summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the fulfillment of conditions to close the sale of its indirect holdings in Ellomay Luzon Energy Shares. The transaction triggers a conditional early repayment of the company's Series E Secured Debentures, with an aggregate repayment of approximately NIS 170 million (~$49.7M) including principal, accrued interest, and prepayment fee, scheduled for May 24, 2026. The debentures are secured by the sold shares, and upon repayment, the pledges will be cancelled. The company may waive the condition. Watch for closing timing and potential impact on capital structure.
